{{Top|leg}}
The '''School of the Arts''' was part of [[Reena University/Legends|Reena University]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reena/Legends|Reena]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The institution was dominant in the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]], and regularly staged free performances such as art shows, music recitals, and concerts.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
